## RSS / Blog Announcements Auto-Posted to Discord

Your Discord community hears about every new blog post, release note, or status update the hour it ships - without a mod copy-pasting links.

**Setup time:** 5 minutes  ·  **Level:** Beginner

**You'll need accounts/credentials for:** RSS, Discord

**Replace these before running:**
- `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_FEED`

**Setup steps:**
1. Paste your feed URL into the RSS node (e.g. https://yourblog.com/rss.xml or a GitHub releases.atom).
2. In Discord: channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks > New Webhook, copy the URL into the Discord node's webhook credential.
3. Activate the workflow. New feed items appear in the channel within the hour.

Free templates and updates: navkhan103.github.io

### How it runs

Starts from **Every Hour**.

1. A Schedule Trigger polls every hour.
2. An RSS node reads the feed (your blog, a GitHub releases feed, a status page - anything with RSS).
3. A Code node keeps only items published since the last hour, so nothing posts twice.
4. A Discord node sends each new item to your channel via webhook: title, link, and a one-line summary.

### If something breaks

The read and AI nodes here **retry 3× automatically** (5s apart), which absorbs rate limits and brief timeouts.

Nodes that **send or write deliberately do not retry** — a send that reached the far end but lost its response would otherwise fire twice, so you'd get duplicate messages or duplicate rows.

To be told when one of those fails, build a workflow starting with an **Error Trigger** node that posts to Slack or email, then set it under **three-dot menu > Settings > Error Workflow**. Do it once and point every workflow at it.
